artboards.title: S4 · Usage & Billing on Free (where Upgrade lands)

annotations.text:
Flow 5, settings and billing. Locked 19 Aug 2026 with Wasim.

The gear at the bottom of the sidebar opens a settings modal over whatever is on screen (the workspace stays put behind it). Left nav: General, Usage & Billing, Notifications. One pane at a time, grouped rows on a cream surface, one serif heading, captions instead of subtitles. Close with × or Esc. The four old routes and the popover menu are gone.

S1 General: Account (avatar, name, email with copy, Sign out), Profile (name, phone, location, photo), Sign-in and security (password, two-factor toggle, signed in with), Preferences (timezone, date format), Account data (delete, one quiet row).

S2 Usage & Billing: Usage first (credits left this month, reset date, what the month's credits went on, the price of each action), then Billing (plan row with Manage billing to the Stripe portal; credit pack row), then Plans (Free / Plus / Max cards, one gold CTA on the upgrade target). Free says top-5 daily feed.
S3 Notifications: 'Email me when' with five toggles, one line each, and the address they go to.
S4: where 'Upgrade to Plus' and 'See Plus' land: the same Usage & Billing pane on a Free account, Plus highlighted with the gold CTA. No separate pricing modal inside the app.
